target.title: Add GitNexus adoption and benchmark guide
target.body:
Closes #442.
Related to #439 and #440.

## TLDR

This PR explains how maintainers can evaluate GitNexus as ClawSweeper's optional code-map layer. PR #440 proposes the default-off review hook; this follow-up explains why the hook is useful, how to operate it, how to benchmark it, and how to avoid overstating what it proves.

GitNexus does not replace the checked-out repository or GitHub diff. It gives ClawSweeper a prepared map of related files, symbols, callers, and flows so the model spends less time rediscovering the same large codebase during every review.

## What changed

- Adds `docs/gitnexus-adoption.md` with a plain-English maintainer guide for what GitNexus does, when it helps, what it cannot prove, and how to roll it out safely.
- Adds `docs/gitnexus-benchmarks.md` with an advisory benchmark plan for token use, runtime, tool calls, review-quality replay, stale-index behavior, and secret safety.
- Adds `scripts/gitnexus-adoption-benchmark.mjs` and `pnpm run gitnexus:benchmark` so maintainers can normalize benchmark dry-run results into JSON.
- Adds focused tests for normalized benchmark output, impossible seeded-finding counts, and fractional count metrics.
- Links the adoption and benchmark docs from the README.

## ClawSweeper feedback addressed

- The benchmark helper now rejects impossible evidence such as `--seeded-findings-caught 4 --seeded-findings-total 3`.
- Count-like fields are now non-negative integers, so the helper rejects fractional tool-call or finding counts.
- The benchmark guide now uses portable artifact locations instead of a contributor-local `/Volumes/LEXAR/...` path.
- The adoption guide now says PR #440 proposes the hook and this page is an adoption proposal until that hook is accepted or merged.
- Real behavior proof is included below.

## Voyage AI note

The docs describe Voyage AI as one possible embedding backend, not as a hard dependency. The public guidance uses conservative wording and cites the official Voyage docs:

- Voyage pricing: https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/pricing
- Voyage rate limits: https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/rate-limits

The current Voyage pricing page says the first 200M tokens are free for `voyage-code-3`, with paid usage after that. The rate-limit page describes account/project limits and tier increases. These terms can change, so the adoption doc says to verify them before enabling credentials or budgeting a rollout.

## Proof boundary

This PR may say GitNexus is expected to reduce repeated discovery work and that NeonDiff experience suggests savings may be significant, potentially up to 50%. It does not claim ClawSweeper has proven 50% savings. Only measured ClawSweeper benchmark results should be treated as actual savings.

## Real behavior proof

Representative dry-run command:

```sh
pnpm run gitnexus:benchmark -- \
  --scenario auth-session-seeded \
  --baseline-tokens 100000 \
  --gitnexus-tokens 60000 \
  --baseline-runtime-ms 120000 \
  --gitnexus-runtime-ms 90000 \
  --baseline-tool-calls 30 \
  --gitnexus-tool-calls 18 \
  --seeded-findings-caught 3 \
  --seeded-findings-total 3 \
  --false-positive-count 0 \
  --graph-freshness fresh
```

Redacted output:

```json
{
  "evalName": "clawsweeper-gitnexus-adoption-v0.1",
  "scenario": "auth-session-seeded",
  "baselineTokens": 100000,
  "gitnexusTokens": 60000,
  "tokenDeltaPercent": 40,
  "baselineRuntimeMs": 120000,
  "gitnexusRuntimeMs": 90000,
  "runtimeDeltaPercent": 25,
  "baselineToolCalls": 30,
  "gitnexusToolCalls": 18,
  "toolCallDelta": 12,
  "seededFindingsCaught": 3,
  "seededFindingsTotal": 3,
  "falsePositiveCount": 0,
  "graphFreshness": "fresh",
  "secretLeakageDetected": false
}
```

Invalid metric command:

```sh
node scripts/gitnexus-adoption-benchmark.mjs --seeded-findings-caught 4 --seeded-findings-total 3
```

Output:

```text
Error: --seeded-findings-caught cannot exceed --seeded-findings-total
Run with --help for usage.
```

## Validation

Local focused checks run from `/Volumes/LEXAR/repos/clawsweeper`:

- `pnpm run gitnexus:benchmark -- --scenario auth-session-seeded --baseline-tokens 100000 --gitnexus-tokens 60000 --baseline-runtime-ms 120000 --gitnexus-runtime-ms 90000 --baseline-tool-calls 30 --gitnexus-tool-calls 18 --seeded-findings-caught 3 --seeded-findings-total 3 --false-positive-count 0 --graph-freshness fresh`
- `node scripts/gitnexus-adoption-benchmark.mjs --seeded-findings-caught 4 --seeded-findings-total 3` exits 1 with the expected error.
- `node --test test/gitnexus-adoption-benchmark.test.ts`
- `pnpm run check:active-surface`
- `pnpm run lint:scripts`
- `pnpm run format:check`
- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm run build`
- `node --test test/review-content-cache.test.ts test/decision-parser.test.ts test/gitnexus-adoption-benchmark.test.ts`

Full `pnpm check` remains the GitHub Actions gate.
